data.name: Spirit's Shadow Maze: The Path of Possession 灵影迷宫：附身之途
data.detailed_description:
In this mysterious 2D maze adventure game, you will embark on a fantasy journey that combines exploration, combat, and strategy. The core gameplay revolves around a unique "possession" mechanism — instead of controlling a single fixed character, you can possess other characters within the maze, flexibly switching perspectives and abilities to find your way through the nested labyrinths. Each maze is randomly generated every time, making every adventure filled with unknowns and freshness.​

Every floor of the maze presents an unknown challenge: intricate paths hide secrets, and only with the guidance of the minimap can you lock onto the exit direction in the mist-like corridors. But the exploration is never peaceful — various uniquely shaped monsters will attack at any time, requiring you to control your possessed character to fight back. Defeating monsters not only grants experience to strengthen your character but also drops glowing crystals — the key to unlocking talents. Accumulate enough crystals to level up your talents, then choose one of three randomly appearing buffs to enhance your adventure, whether it's boosting attack power, increasing defense, or unlocking special skills, adding more strategy to your journey.​

A standout feature is the teammate recruitment system: during exploration, you'll encounter other NPCs. You can either collaborate with them or defeat them to recruit them as teammates. If your possessed character unfortunately falls, there's no need to start over — the system will automatically let you possess a recruited teammate to continue the adventure. As the maze floors increase, monster difficulty and maze complexity escalate, while continuously unlocked talents and an expanding teammate roster become your core motivation to overcome challenges.​

From cautious initial steps in the maze to later mastery with talents and teammates, every exploration brims with freshness, and every choice influences the pace of the adventure. Are you ready to start this "possession-based" maze adventure? The exit lies ahead, and every step toward it is in your hands.

data.short_description: A 2D top-down maze exploration game blending exploration, combat, and strategy. Navigate randomly generated mazes with shifting paths that keep each run fresh. Face escalating challenges as you climb through floors, defeating monsters and seeking exits to progress further in the labyrinth.
